basic_info.description: This rare and spacious 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom Victorian flat is quintessential San Francisco! Combining original period details with thoughtful upgrades throughout, the generous and flexible floorplan is ideal for living, entertaining and working. You'll fall in love with the high ceilings, abundant natural light and Bay windows. Enjoy the modern updates including recently refinished floors, new light fixtures, tastefully-tiled bathrooms, and smart home devices. The kitchen boasts a newly-installed oven, stainless steel microwave and plentiful storage. A separate mudroom hosts the convenience of a shower and in-unit laundry that leads directly to the serene, shared courtyard. A large, independent garage and additional storage area completes this home.    Nestled in the Inner Mission on a tree-lined street, this home is centrally-located to some of the city's best restaurants, bars, entertainment and shopping. Just moments away from multiple transit lines and the freeway, this is city living at its finest.
